rules.clause_label: 3(a) Hosted Service restriction and single-customer exception
rules.scope_note: Use of the Software, in whole or in part, to provide a Hosted Service to third parties is prohibited without prior written authorization. The text gives examples including multi-tenant platforms, managed services enabling third parties to create, configure, or run agents, and reselling cloud access. Exception: deployment for one customer in a dedicated single-tenant environment is allowed only if it serves that customer exclusively; the customer grants no access to or shares it with another third party; use is solely for that customer's internal business operations and is not a reusable multi-customer platform; it is not shared across tenants; and FIM One branding, product names, copyright notices, and branding remain visible and unaltered.
rules.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the licensee provides a Hosted Service to third parties without prior written authorization and the single-customer exception's requirements are not all met. The exception requires all five listed conditions; prior written authorization is a separate route stated in the text.
rules.source_excerpt:
(a) HOSTED SERVICE RESTRICTION. You may NOT use the Software, in whole or
    in part, to provide a Hosted Service to third parties without prior
    written authorization from Licensor. This includes, but is not limited
    to:
    - Offering "FIM One-as-a-Service" or similar multi-tenant platforms;
    - Operating a managed service where third parties create, configure, or
      run agents using the Software;
    - Reselling access to the Software's functionality as a cloud service.

    Exception: You MAY deploy the Software for a single customer in a
    dedicated, single-tenant environment, provided that:
    (i)   the deployment serves only that one customer exclusively;
    (ii)  the customer does not grant access to, or share the deployment
          with, any other third party;
    (iii) the Software is used solely for that customer's internal business
          operations and is not offered as a reusable platform service
          across multiple customers;
    (iv)  the Software is not shared across multiple tenants; and
    (v)   all FIM One trademarks, product names, copyright notices, and
          branding remain visible and unaltered.
